top_stories.title: Massive Leak Exposes 41,000 Homeland Security Workers
top_stories.summary: A data leak has exposed records of over 41,000 DHS employees and contractors, including approximately 10,000 ICE personnel. The data was reportedly taken from DHS's Okta login system and includes phone numbers, email addresses, office addresses, and reporting relationships.

top_stories.title: AI cybersecurity shifts to governing agents with Okta identity
top_stories.summary: Okta is addressing AI agent governance as a new frontier in identity management, focusing on establishing identity, authority, and boundaries for software agents acting across enterprise systems. The article covers how AI cybersecurity is shifting from perimeter defense to governing what trusted AI agents are permitted to do, a direct evolution of IAM principles.

top_stories.title: Microsoft urges Entra ID admins to migrate users to passkeys
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is urging Entra ID administrators to migrate users from SMS and voice authentication to phishing-resistant methods such as passkeys. Microsoft has set a February 2027 deadline for retiring SMS and voice authentication in Entra ID, after which users who have not migrated will face sign-in disruptions.

top_stories.title: Fake IT help desk callers got by on little more than names and email addresses
top_stories.summary: Cisco Talos Incident Response documented multiple Q3 2026 engagements where attackers impersonated IT help desk staff via phone, email, and Microsoft Teams to trick employees into opening remote access sessions. Attackers used only employee names and email addresses to social-engineer targets, with at least one incident resulting in ransomware deployment.

top_stories.title: American Organizations Under Attack: Skyw4lker Device Code Phishing Campaign Exposed
top_stories.summary: A phishing campaign dubbed "Skyw4lker" is targeting U.S. organizations by abusing device code authentication flows in cloud services rather than traditional credential theft. The attack exploits legitimate authentication mechanisms to gain access to corporate accounts while evading conventional detection methods.

news.title: Binance hit by $6.3 billion theft in what could be the biggest crypto heist on record
news.summary: Binance suffered a $6.3 billion cryptocurrency theft traced to a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, which gave attackers access to a service container enabling unauthorized withdrawal transactions. The breach involved compromised endpoint credentials and lateral movement into backend systems, with no evidence of wallet private key leakage found.

news.title: 26,400 Valid Cloud and AI Credentials Found Exposed in Public Gitee Repositories
news.summary: Researcher Ben Zimmermann discovered 26,400 valid credentials exposed in public Gitee repositories after scanning 7.25 million repos, with results reported on October 28. The exposed credentials were primarily API keys for cloud and AI services, representing active authentication secrets that remained functional at the time of discovery.

news.title: Massive data breach exposes 40,000 US Homeland Security employees
news.summary: A data breach exposed sensitive personal information of over 40,000 U.S. Department of Homeland Security employees, including those in surveillance and human intelligence roles. The breach raises concerns about access controls and identity protection for federal personnel with sensitive security clearances.

news.title: Personal data of 40,000 U.S. Homeland Security employees leaked in security breach
news.summary: A data breach exposed personal information of more than 40,000 U.S. Department of Homeland Security employees, with the data published by the leak site Distributed Denial of Secrets. The compromised data includes details on officials working in sensitive fields such as surveillance and human intelligence.

news.title: Leak website releases data on thousands of US Homeland Security employees
news.summary: A data breach exposed personal details of more than 40,000 Department of Homeland Security employees, including identities, contact details, and job titles. Distributed Denial of Secrets claims responsibility for releasing the leaked data on their website.

news.title: A hacker stole more than 40,000 DHS employee records
news.summary: A hacker stole personal records of more than 41,000 Department of Homeland Security employees, including names, job titles, phone numbers, email addresses, and office locations. The breach raises concerns about identity exposure for federal employees, including those in sensitive immigration-related roles.

news.title: Dell expands cyber recovery tools to protect identity
news.summary: Dell Technologies is expanding its cyber recovery tools to include identity system protection, addressing the risk of compromised access control infrastructure during cyberattacks. The expansion positions identity resilience as a core component of cyber recovery alongside traditional data protection.

news.title: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
news.summary: Akamai launched a security product for AI agents, joining Okta, Palo Alto, Cisco, CrowdStrike, and Zscaler in a growing market for protecting autonomous AI software. The article covers the emerging cybersecurity spending category around AI agent security, with Okta among the vendors offering protection for software that acts autonomously.

news.title: Dell Ships Quantum-Safe Fibre Channel Encryption on PowerStore in November, Adds Identity Recovery and AI Factory Hardening to PowerProtect
news.summary: Dell Technologies announced updates to its cyber resilience portfolio, including identity recovery features in PowerProtect and quantum-safe encryption for PowerStore. The identity recovery component is a minor addition within a broader storage and infrastructure product announcement.

news.title: Dell extends cyber resilience to identity, AI environments and quantum-safe storage
news.summary: Dell Technologies has extended its cyber resilience portfolio to include identity systems via PowerProtect software, which can restore compromised identity platforms to a clean, trusted state after an attack. The identity protection capability is one of three focus areas in the release, alongside AI environments and quantum-safe storage.

news.title: Trust Is Not What It Seems — and Fraudsters Are Counting on It
news.summary: Threat actors are bypassing technical security controls by using AI-assisted social engineering to manipulate help desks into granting unauthorized access. The attack vector targets identity verification weaknesses in help desk procedures, directly undermining authentication and access management controls.

news.title: AI Agents as Insider Threats: Inside Microsoft's Bet on a Unified Security Stack
news.summary: Microsoft has announced Project Perception, which introduces Guardian Agents designed to monitor and contain anomalous AI agent behavior within enterprise environments. Security experts are raising concerns that using AI agents to police other AI agents could introduce additional risk, particularly as autonomous agents increasingly operate with privileged access and identity contexts.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. The company attributed the accelerated vulnerability discovery to AI, while security experts noted that organizations are struggling to prioritize and deploy the high volume of monthly patches.
